tei:div.tei:p: 65) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye:

dad dang dam tshig ldan pa'i bus: byin rlabs dngos grub 'thob pa'i phyir: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma la: gsol ba 'debs pa'i thabs zab mo: byin rlabs sprin phung 'di la brtson: sa ma ya: dad mos gdung shugs drag po yis: dus drug gsol ba 'di ltar gdab: e ma hoḥ chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems: sprul sku 'gro ba'i mgon po dga' rab rje: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rim gnyis mthar phyin mchog gi dngos grub stsol: mkhas grub chen po shrī seng ha dang: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen nā gardzu na la: gsol ba= rim gnyis= rtogs pa phul phyin bī ma la mi tra: rom+bu gu h+ya shīn+taṃ ghar+bha ta: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa laḥ gsol ba= rim gnyis= dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag pad+ma 'byung: lhan skyes ye shes ḍā ki mtsho rgyal mar: gsol ba= rim gnyis= thugs kyi sras mchog grub brnyes rje 'bangs dang: bai ro nam snying zhi ba rdo rje mtsho: gsol ba= 66)rim gnyis= snying dbus mi 'gyur thig le'i gzhal yas nas: rig sku mngon gyur pad+ma las 'brel la: gsol ba= rim gnyis= zab gter mnga' bdag su kha badz+ra dang: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams la: gsol ba= rim gnyis= tshad med thugs rje'i rang gzugs ye shes gar: sgo skyong chen po rgyal chen sde bzhi la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad solaḥ phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub dngos grub stsolaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las dregs pa'i gtso: dbyings kyi rje mo sprul 'khor bcas pa dang: zab gter bka' yi srung ma thams cad la: gsol ba 'debs so mi mthun bar chad bzlog: tshe sgrub mthar phyin mchog gi dngos grub stsol: de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bskyed rim rnam dag snod bcud lha skur dag: rdzogs rim rtsa rlung thig le gnad smin nas: rdzogs pa chen por 'khor 'das dag mnyam rdzogs:

tshe 'dir 'chi ba'i lam la ma ltos bar: rang snang 'og min dpal ri'i zhing khams su: rig stong rdo rje phag mo'i skur gyur nas: rigs bdag pad 'byung nyid dang dbyer med du: 'ja' lus gzhon nu bum skur byang chub shog: de ltar mi phyed 67) dad pa yis: dus gsum chag med gsol btab na: tshe yi 'du byed dbyings nub tshe: dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mdun bsus te: pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du: zung 'jug sprul ba'i lus thob nas: gu ru pad+ma'i zhabs drung du: 'khor gyi thog mar skye bar 'gyur: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis kyang: snying mig srog dang mtshungs pa'i chos: thugs dam zab mo 'di yin kyang: las ldan rdo rje zhi ba mtshor: gces nor tshul du chos 'di gdams: ma 'ongs nyi shu kha ral dus: nga min nga yi sprul pa mchog: chu 'brug lo ba su kha'i ming: dpral bar tām̐ḥgyi ri mo gsal: g.yu sgra'i sprul pa dang 'phrad nas: chos 'di'i sgo 'phar 'byed par nges: las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: log rtog mkhan gyi dbang po snubs: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs la gtad: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: dam ldan bu la chos 'di sprod: gter rkun lag tu ma shor cig: sa ma ya: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs kyi rgya: (Dakini secret letter here) gu h+ya: brda thim: ces pa 'di'ang tshe ring mas brdas bskul tshe dus mtha'i chos gzugs bde skyong dbang mos ser dgon dben phrod nas snang gsal mthongs la 'phral du bris pa'o/
